<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:16%; font-size:12pt; font-family:Arial" ALIGN="justify"><B>Important Notice Regarding the Availability of Materials </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:24pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:15%; font-size:11pt; font-family:Arial" ALIGN="justify"><B>ANAPTYSBIO, INC. </B></P>
<P STYLE="font-size:48pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P><DIV STYLE="position:relative;float:left; width:48%;padding-right:0%;padding-bottom:8pt;overflow:visible;padding-top:3pt">

<TR STYLE="page-break-inside:avoid ; font-family:Arial; font-size:6pt">
<TD VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:6pt; font-family:Arial" ALIGN="justify">You are receiving this communication because you hold shares of common stock in AnaptysBio, Inc. (&#8220;AnaptysBio&#8221;). AnaptysBio
has released informational materials regarding its <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">spin-off</FONT> of its biopharma operations business (&#8220;First Tracks Biotherapeutics&#8221;) that are now available for your review. These materials consist of
the Information Statement, plus any supplements, that AnaptysBio has prepared in connection with the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">spin-off.</FONT> <B>This</B> <B>notice provides instructions on how to access AnaptysBio materials for
informational purposes only.</B> <B>It is not a form for voting and presents only an overview of the AnaptysBio materials, which contain important information and are available, free of charge, on the Internet or by mail. We encourage you to access
and review the AnaptysBio materials on the Internet at www.materialnotice.com.</B> <B>AnaptysBio is not asking you for a proxy and you are asked not to send a proxy</B>. The <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">spin-off</FONT> consists of the proposed
distribution of 100% of First Tracks Biotherapeutics shares of common stock to holders of AnaptysBio shares of common stock on a pro rata basis. <B>If you want to receive a paper copy of the informational materials, you must request one. There is no
charge to you for requesting a copy. Please make your request for a copy as instructed on the reverse side of this notice.</B></P> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt; margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt" align="left">&nbsp;</P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:6pt; font-family:Arial" ALIGN="justify">You may view the materials online at <I>www.materialnotice.com </I>and easily request a paper or <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">e-mail</FONT> copy (see
reverse side).</P> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt; margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:1pt" align="left">&nbsp;</P></TD></TR>
<TR BGCOLOR="#000000" STYLE="page-break-inside:avoid ; font-family:Arial; font-size:11pt">

side for instructions on how to access materials.</FONT></B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="font-size:1pt; margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:1pt" align="left">&nbsp;</P></TD></TR>
